device.pairing_in_progress_hint: Please unlock your device and click "Trust," then enter your passcode if prompted.

operations.install_anderstore_success_message: Open AnderStore on your iPhone. If it does not launch, enable Developer Mode and trust the profile in Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.

pairing.name: Name
pairing.advanced_export_message: This is not recommended unless you know what you're doing. Press "Place" next to an app to transfer it automatically instead. Are you sure you still want to export your pairing file?

settings.reset_anisette_message: Are you sure you want to reset the anisette state? You will be required to enter your 2FA code again.
settings.delete_stored_rppairing_message: Are you sure you want to delete the stored pairing file for this device? This will require you to pair again.
settings.dont_use_keyring_message: This makes AnderStore Installer less secure by storing pairing files, anisette state, and certificates on disk. Enable this only if the default keyring storage doesn't work and you understand the risks.

error.title: An Error Occured: {{msg}}

underage: Your Apple ID may be below the required age to use developer services.
account_locked: Don't panic! This usually occurs after multiple failed login attempts, but it is completely harmless.
auth: If you see 429 or "Too Many Requests", Apple has temporarily limited sign-ins. Wait 30-60 minutes and try once.
Make sure your credentials are correct and try again, even if they were correct.
If the issue persists, try using another Apple ID.
Security Key 2FA is not supported. If possible, use an Apple ID with no 2FA or with trusted device 2FA.
download: Download AnderStore.ipa manually from ((link:https://github.com/ANDRESOTRU/AnderStore/releases/tag/nightly)) and try again.
house_arrest: [ios::26.3]Ensure your device is not on a developer beta of iOS 26.3, as it has a bug with house arrest
pairing: Try reconnecting the device and running the action again.
Ensure your device has a passcode set.
Ensure your device is connected via USB, not wirelessly.
usbmuxd: [platform::windows]Ensure you have ((link:https://apple.co/ms:iTunes)) installed and check that it can detect your device.
[platform::windows]Uninstall iTunes and Apple Mobile Device Support, then install "Apple Devices" from the Microsoft Store.
[platform::linux]Make sure usbmuxd is installed and running.
trust: Unlock your device, go to the home screen, and accept any trust prompts that appear.
device_coms: Ensure your device is properly connected to your computer.
Unplug and reconnect the device. If the issue persists, try a different USB port and cable.
not_logged_in: Sign in to your Apple ID first.
anisette: Make sure this computer is connected to the internet.
Try again in a minute — the sign-in server may be temporarily unavailable.
Check that ((link:{{anisetteServerUrl}})) opens in your browser.
keyring: Try enabling "Don't use keyring" in settings to bypass this issue. Note that this is less secure.
misc: Click the button again. If it doesn't help, restart the app and reconnect the iPhone.
admin: Try running the app with elevated permissions (as administrator/root).
filesystem: Make sure AnderStore Installer has permission to read and write files on your system.
not_enough_app_ids: You do not have enough App IDs available to install this app.
Wait for App IDs to expire after 7 days (cannot be deleted sooner), then try again.
Installing apps from AnderStore on the iPhone uses fewer App IDs, so try installing from there instead.
max_apps: You can only have 3 sideloaded apps installed at a time with a free Apple ID.
Delete other sideloaded apps to free up space for this one.
Expired apps still count towards the 3 app limit.

error.support_message: If the error keeps happening, click “Copy to clipboard” and open the <github>help page</github>.

update.new_version_available: A new version is available: {{version}}. Do you want to update?
update.up_to_date: AnderStore Installer is up to date.

prepare.title: Prepare your computer
prepare.lead: Let's check that this computer can talk to your iPhone. You only do this once.
prepare.ok: All set, the computer can see Apple devices.
prepare.missing_step1: Click “Download iTunes” — Microsoft Store will open.
prepare.missing_step2: Install iTunes and open it once.
prepare.waiting: Install iTunes first, then click “Check again”.

connect.title: Connect your iPhone
connect.lead: Plug your iPhone into this computer with a cable.
connect.step1: Connect the iPhone with a cable and unlock it.
connect.step2: If the iPhone asks “Trust This Computer?” — tap “Trust” and enter your passcode.
connect.step3: Click your iPhone in the list below. Not there? Click “Refresh”.
connect.waiting: Select your iPhone in the list to continue.

account.title: Sign in with Apple ID
account.lead: An Apple ID is needed to sign AnderStore for your iPhone for free.
account.note_free: A regular free Apple ID works. A separate one is recommended.
account.note_privacy: Your email and password are only sent to Apple.
account.note_code: Apple will send a 6-digit code to your iPhone or Mac — enter it here.

install.title: Install AnderStore
install.lead: Click the button and wait 1–3 minutes. Keep the iPhone connected.
install.note_cable: Don't unplug or lock the iPhone until it finishes.
install.failed: Installation failed. Follow the tip in the error window and click the button again.

finish.title: 4 last steps on your iPhone
finish.lead: AnderStore is on your iPhone. To open it, do this on the phone:
finish.devmode_path: Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode → On. The iPhone restarts, then tap “Turn On”.
finish.trust_path: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → your Apple ID → “Trust”.
finish.vpn_path: Find the free LocalDevVPN app in the App Store and install it. AnderStore uses it to renew its signature.
finish.open_path: Find the AnderStore icon on your Home Screen and open it.
finish.weekly: Important: every 7 days open AnderStore and tap “Refresh”, or your apps will stop opening. AnderStore will remind you.
